title: I can't stand the feel!
text: I can't stand the feel!. Gross to touch! Finish is so mat - they grab skin or something. I cant stand touching the handles. Look so neat but dread using them. I hate to touch to rinse them too. It hasnt worn off or improved. I put out for serving or company.

product_metadata.title: Gourmet Settings 4-Piece Spreader Knife Set-Treble Clef Collection-Polished/Matte Cheese and Butter Spreading Knives
features: ELEGANT DESIGN: This spreader set combines a matte and mirror polish finish with a unique twist to achieve a refined look perfect for any modern or traditional table
INCLUDES: Premium 4-piece spreaders set of 6 3/4 inch length with comfortable ergonomic design and smooth blades making for a heavy feel and even-spread
WORRY-FREE: Dishwasher safe and rust-resistant. Durable 18/10 stainless steel set built to stand the test of time. No chipping and no color fading, perfect for daily use
VERSATILITY: This knife set is perfectly-suited for any type of spreadable appetizer, cheese ball, bagel, butter, dip, jam, or jelly. Ideal for any party or as a gift during holiday season
OUR STORY: Gourmet Settings is committed to designing beautiful and affordable silverware for all dining occasions. Backed by a 25-year warranty
description: GOURMET SETTINGS At Gourmet Settings we are obsessed with design. We are constantly refining our silverware sets to ensure ergonomic integrity, timeless design, and a beautiful finish suitable for any occasion. All Gourmet Settings patterns have been meticulously designed, engineered and tested to be perfectly weighted and balanced, ensuring optimal performance and comfort you have to feel to believe. Our silverware sets are made with premium stainless steel and are to last for years to come. Every time you pick up your fork we want to bring a little smile to your face! QUALITY: Unique stainless steel flatware sets focused on best design and size variety for comfort and performance. FINISH: This matte and mirror polish spreading knife set maintains it's finish perfectly without need for additional polishing and has been built for both sturdiness and elegance. SUITABILITY: Suited to everyday dining or casual occasions alongside any existing sets and tableware. WHAT'S INCLUDED? 4 x Spreaders Length = 6 3/4"
